description.zh:
保证请求的幂等性。 该值由客户端生成，并且必须是全局唯一的。   
长度最大为64个字符，可包含英文字符、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。  
更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~134212~~)。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests.

The token can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-) and underscores (\_).

For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~134212~~).

description.zh: 资源逻辑ID，即模板中资源的名称。
description.en: The logical ID of the resource as defined in the template.

description.zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
信号的状态。故障信号会导致无法创建或更新资源栈，如果所有信号都是警告信号，则将无法创建或更新资源栈。取值：

- SUCCESS
- FAILURE
- WARNING
description.en:
The status of the signal. Failure signals can cause stack creation or update to fail. If all signals are warnings, the stack cannot be created or updated. Valid values:

- SUCCESS

- FAILURE

- WARNING

description.zh: 信号的唯一ID。长度为1~64个字符。如果向单个资源发送多个信号（例如发信号通知等待条件），则每个信号都需要不同的信息ID。
description.en: The unique ID of the signal. The ID must be 1 to 64 characters in length. If multiple signals are sent to a single resource, each signal must have a unique ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros signal-resource --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --status SUCCESS --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --unique-id 27c7347b-352a-4377-accf-63d361c10000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --logical-resource-id WebServer --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ros SignalResource --region cn-hangzhou --Status SUCCESS --UniqueId '27c7347b-352a-4377-accf-63d361c10000' --LogicalResourceId WebServer --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --StackId '4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000'
